classification.difficultyReason: Direct recognition or a familiar short procedure. Combines the odd-integer roster with the taught divisibility condition.

content.prompt:
Write the following description of a set in set notation.

Odd integers between 100 and 200.

answer.worked:
The first odd integer is 101. Increase by 2, ending at 199:
$$\{101,103,\ldots,199\}.$$
Equivalently,
$$\left\{x\in\mathbb Z\text{ where }100<x<200\text{ and }\frac{x+1}{2}\in\mathbb Z\right\}.$$
